summary: Plug and Play Fund Management I, LLC (CRD 321635) is an exempt reporting adviser with 5 venture funds and $130.5M of private-fund gross assets. IAPD flags no disclosure. Treasury penalized its parent, Amidi, LLC, $200,000 in 2026 for a missed outbound-investment notification. No founder lawsuit was found.

takeaways.title: The score comes down to one regulatory penalty.
takeaways.text: Treasury fined the parent company, Amidi, LLC, $200,000 in 2026 for not notifying it of an investment by a Chinese subsidiary fund. That is −10.

takeaways.title: The SEC adviser record and the OFAC check show nothing.

matters.text: Cardinal Management Services sued a former contractor, White, in federal court in Florida over a doctored contract. The complaint names Plug and Play only as the other side of a 2019 services contract and says Plug and Play had no knowledge of the doctored version.

pen.title: Regulatory penalty
pen.body: In July 2026 Treasury issued its first civil penalty under the Outbound Investment Security Program: $200,000 to Amidi, LLC, for not notifying Treasury of a roughly $92,478 investment by its Chinese subsidiary fund in Shanghai Qiongche Intelligent Technology (Noematrix) on April 19, 2025. Treasury says Amidi is the parent of the organization that does business as Plug and Play Tech Center. No harmed investor or founder and no fraud finding, so −10, the bottom of the fine band. The SEC adviser itself (CRD 321635) has no disclosure flagged on IAPD.
